P.h: Vghost: Linux vhost bug gives any local user root
P.p: CVE-2026-74580 (CVSS 8.8) lets anyone who can open /dev/vhost-net or /dev/vhost-vsock read and write kernel memory and escalate to root. Kernels 4.11 through 7.2 are affected. Tencent Zhuque Lab confirmed root on five major distros, and showed a malicious VM guest can hijack the host's QEMU process.
P.s: Patch to a kernel with fix de845981da67. Until then, remove world access from both device nodes. RHEL, Amazon Linux, Azure Linux and Oracle Linux expose them by default.

items.h: Claude Code used in campaign stealing 628,000 Ukrainian records
items.d: CyberXero ran 51 agents, PentAGI and Cobalt Strike. One run hit 4,708 targets and dropped 32 web shells in 61 seconds. Operators claimed authorized testing to bypass refusals.
CVE-2026-107181 on 7.2.8 and earlier: a crafted tg: link injects a helper that uploads session files. Update to 7.2.9, set a local passcode.

items.h: AhsayCBS flaws exploited for webshells and mining
items.d: Huntress sees an auth bypass chained with RCE to install JSP shells and XMRig. Version 10.3.4 reportedly still vulnerable.

items.h: GhostAction phishing steals GitHub passwords and TOTP
items.d: A reverse-proxy kit approves an OAuth device flow with repo and workflow scopes. Revoke the grants, rotate CI/CD secrets, audit .github/workflows.

P.h: Anthropic launches a critical infrastructure defense program
P.p: The Critical Infrastructure Defense Program partners Anthropic with CrowdShield, Dragos, Nozomi Networks and Rockwell Automation. Claude models and threat research go into vulnerability assessment and patching for water, power and transport systems.
P.s: Anthropic also introduced OSS Scanner, a free opt-in service sending maintainers model-generated vulnerability reports. 85 of 97 critical or high findings met its disclosure bar.

tiles.t: Copilot to act on local files

P.h: DigitalOcean MicroVMs give AI agents isolated compute
P.p: MicroVMs are in public preview, built on Firecracker. Instances pause when idle and resume in milliseconds. Compute costs $0.022 per vCPU-hour and $0.0085 per GiB-hour, billed per second, and paused instances pay only for storage.
P.s: Target workloads are coding agents, sandboxes and CI/CD runners.
